PART  
1.3  

During Re-entrant Fires | 3 Different Window-Fire Damage Patterns  

Room █05 (Type A)  
- Fully-developed fire in whole room unit  
- Sufficient fuel to sustain fire development after glass breakage  

Room █05 (Type A)  
- Localised fire in living room  
- Limited fuel ignited after glass breakage  
- Early glass fallout (“active opening”)  

Room █05 (Type A)  
- No fire in living room  
- Full glass breakage, excluding internal fire, ejecting flames from lower floor  
- Glass fallout only due to re-entrant fire
